comparison_note: 逐档人数、金额标签及已返回比例通过；零人数档允许省略，饼图由人数计算占比
sql: WITH deposit_balances AS ( SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(SUM(h.market_value_amount), 0) AS deposit_balance FROM dim_customer c LEFT JOIN fct_product_holding h ON h.customer_id = c.customer_id AND h.product_category_code = 'DEPOSIT' WHERE c.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND c.region_code = 'EAST' GROUP BY c.customer_id ), bucketed AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN db.deposit_balance < 1000000 THEN '0-100万' WHEN db.deposit_balance < 2000000 THEN '100-200万' WHEN db.deposit_balance < 3000000 THEN '200-300万' WHEN db.deposit_balance < 4000000 THEN '300-400万' WHEN db.deposit_balance < 5000000 THEN '400-500万' WHEN db.deposit_balance < 6000000 THEN '500-600万' WHEN db.deposit_balance < 7000000 THEN '600-700万' WHEN db.deposit_balance < 8000000 THEN '700-800万' WHEN db.deposit_balance < 9000000 THEN '800-900万' ELSE '900-1000万' END AS deposit_band, CASE WHEN db.deposit_balance < 1000000 THEN 0 WHEN db.deposit_balance < 2000000 THEN 100 WHEN db.deposit_balance < 3000000 THEN 200 WHEN db.deposit_balance < 4000000 THEN 300 WHEN db.deposit_balance < 5000000 THEN 400 WHEN db.deposit_balance < 6000000 THEN 500 WHEN db.deposit_balance < 7000000 THEN 600 WHEN db.deposit_balance < 8000000 THEN 700 WHEN db.deposit_balance < 9000000 THEN 800 ELSE 900 END AS band_lower_wan FROM deposit_balances db WHERE db.deposit_balance >= 0 AND db.deposit_balance <= 10000000 ), band_counts AS ( SELECT deposit_band, band_lower_wan, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM bucketed GROUP BY deposit_band, band_lower_wan ) SELECT deposit_band, customer_count, customer_count / SUM(customer_count) OVER () AS customer_ratio FROM band_counts ORDER BY band_lower_wan LIMIT 100

comparison_note: 逐档人数、金额标签及已返回比例通过；零人数档允许省略，饼图由人数计算占比
sql: WITH customer_deposit AS ( SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(SUM(h.market_value_amount), 0) AS deposit_balance FROM dim_customer c LEFT JOIN fct_product_holding h ON c.customer_id = h.customer_id AND h.product_category_code = 'DEPOSIT' WHERE c.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND c.manager_id = 'M0001' GROUP BY c.customer_id ), banded AS ( SELECT customer_id, deposit_balance, CASE WHEN deposit_balance < 500000 THEN '0-50万' WHEN deposit_balance < 1000000 THEN '50-100万' WHEN deposit_balance < 1500000 THEN '100-150万' WHEN deposit_balance < 2000000 THEN '150-200万' WHEN deposit_balance < 2500000 THEN '200-250万' WHEN deposit_balance < 3000000 THEN '250-300万' WHEN deposit_balance < 3500000 THEN '300-350万' WHEN deposit_balance < 4000000 THEN '350-400万' WHEN deposit_balance < 4500000 THEN '400-450万' WHEN deposit_balance < 5000000 THEN '450-500万' WHEN deposit_balance < 5500000 THEN '500-550万' WHEN deposit_balance <= 6000000 THEN '550-600万' END AS deposit_band, CASE WHEN deposit_balance < 500000 THEN 1 WHEN deposit_balance < 1000000 THEN 2 WHEN deposit_balance < 1500000 THEN 3 WHEN deposit_balance < 2000000 THEN 4 WHEN deposit_balance < 2500000 THEN 5 WHEN deposit_balance < 3000000 THEN 6 WHEN deposit_balance < 3500000 THEN 7 WHEN deposit_balance < 4000000 THEN 8 WHEN deposit_balance < 4500000 THEN 9 WHEN deposit_balance < 5000000 THEN 10 WHEN deposit_balance < 5500000 THEN 11 WHEN deposit_balance <= 6000000 THEN 12 END AS band_order FROM customer_deposit WHERE deposit_balance >= 0 AND deposit_balance <= 6000000 ) SELECT deposit_band, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER(), 2) AS customer_pct FROM banded GROUP BY deposit_band, band_order ORDER BY band_order LIMIT 100

comparison_note: 逐性别比较人数，支持常用中文标签
sql: SELECT gender_code, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER(), 2) AS customer_ratio FROM dim_customer c WHERE c.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND c.region_code = 'EAST' GROUP BY gender_code ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 100
